Velocity: ~143 tickets/week

Key themes this window: Gemma4-E2B reached a first official SM8750 eval while tool-call and empty-output defects were cleared on device. Fast-verification flooded the P7 box with Granite, Harrier, OCR, and image services. Davy discovery closed with a written Mitra vs Davy choice. Cycle time median is ~9 days; the ~16-day mean is pulled up by 25 tickets older than 30 days (PE data, Daikin UI, long eval datasets).

p.em: What moved this period, grouped by epic.

h3: 9.5 Gemma4-e2b 1.0 - Local Agent (LATC-6591) — 26 done this period · 58% complete overall
p: This week the local-agent epic actually met a device. Official SM8750 eval was prepared, run, and debugged; MTK inference code landed; QAT/DPO/PTQ recipes closed; and a cluster of tool-call, chat-template, and empty-output defects were filed and cleared. Perception Engine data that had been open for weeks also closed, so training is no longer waiting on unlabeled PE sets. The epic is still only 58% complete overall. The remaining risk is fidelity on-device, not 'can we launch a checkpoint.'
h3: Daikin Supply Chain Planning (LATC-6782) — 18 done this period · 82% complete overall
p: Daikin supply-chain planning took the largest non-model bite of the week. Production dashboards, planned-order filters, demand-planning sales-order flows, permissions, and job notifications all moved to Done. That is productization of a planner UI the BU can operate. It is 82% complete overall and should not be mistaken for model-factory velocity.
h3: Quantization Fast Verification (LATC-3171) — 13 done this period · 93% complete overall
p: Fast verification stayed in deploy-and-measure mode. Granite, Harrier, Gemma distilled, OCR (Tesseract JP, NDLOCR-Lite), and image-turbo services were stood up on the P7 box, with I/O alignment for Qwen3-VL embedding and layout. Long-token Granite and ColModernVBERT also got a look. The epic is 93% complete. The leftover work is mostly the long tail of 'one more checkpoint on the box.'
h3: Ultra-Low Bit Quantization for Large Language Models (LATC-8943) — 7 done this period · 88% complete overall
p: Ultra-low-bit work moved from analysis to phone. GSQ 2-bit/4-bit and mixed 2.8/2.9-bit recipes were tested on Granite embeddings, memory OOMs were diagnosed, and Granite was inferred on MTK via MNN. 88% complete. The open question is quality at those bit widths, not whether the kernels run.
h3: 22.1 AIW: Listen and Act Locally Solution (LATC-8292) — 5 done this period · 49% complete overall
p: Listen-and-act locally got firmware-shaped fixes: 16KB SO alignment, SAD CRLF crash, WhisperASR session lifecycle, plus Granite QNN240 test on SM7635 and low-end Qualcomm inference. 49% complete. Hardware bring-up is still the gate, not model choice.
h3: 33.1 Discovery, access & gap analysis (LATC-8672) — 5 done this period · 91% complete overall
p: Discovery closed. Cloud model-service access, Mitra vs Davy positioning (including PRC), Davy value spike, ROW cohort capacity/quality, and the Confluence gap analysis all landed. The epic is 91% complete and the parent epic itself went Done. Next step is a decision, not more research.
h3: Model Research & Knowledge Activation (LATC-2711) — 4 done this period · 50% complete overall
p: Research tickets closed on 1-2 bit 12B feasibility, KV-cache quantization, llama.cpp gesture, and the ABot-World absorb. 50% complete. This epic will stay a mixed bag until someone sequences the next bets.
h3: DeepSeekV4-Flash 2-Bit Quantization (LATC-9801) — 3 done this period · 60% complete overall
p: DeepSeekV4-Flash 2-bit has an architecture read, a hosting config, and a baseline eval. 60% complete. Enough to say whether the recipe is worth a second week.
h3: 9.7 Gemma-4-26B-A4B Spark Model UX and Safety Enhancement (LATC-6594) — 3 done this period · 92% complete overall
p: Gemma-4-26B safety LoRA hit GGUF conversion, OSC tracking, and a deployment-readiness writeup. 92% complete. This is late-stage packaging, not new training.
h3: 20.1 Model Pillar General (LATC-3853) — 2 done this period · 67% complete overall
p: General pillar work: DeepSeek/GLM/Inkling hosting and an ONNX docs review. 67% complete. Useful, not a theme.
h3: FM Evaluation Integration (LATC-1049) — 2 done this period · 77% complete overall
p: FM evaluation integration closed as an epic. Child work this week was a coding-eval HTML dataset/metric and a voice eval environment. 77% complete on remaining children.
h3: [xCloud]4.5 Benchmark & Data & Agent evaluation for AICS project (LATC-243) — 2 done this period · 100% complete overall
p: AICS eval enablement closed its last two children: evaluation execution/troubleshooting and generalized image-gen/edit QC. 100% complete.
h3: 33.3 LATC value delivery into Davy (LATC-8674) — 2 done this period · 100% complete overall
p: Both Davy harness-comparison stories closed. 100% complete. Combined with 33.1, the Davy conversation now has discovery and a value-delivery comparison.
h3: 9.10 On-Device Speech Translation V2 (LATC-8295) — 2 done this period · 22% complete overall
p: On-device speech translation shipped a stable Android QA build and a desktop-switch bug fix. 22% complete. Testability improved; the model/SDK work is still early.
h3: Flux2Klein v1 (LATC-6592) — 2 done this period · 42% complete overall
p: Flux2Klein got a compositional edit test and a soft-mask distillation strategy. 42% complete. Editing quality is still the open problem.
h3: Data Agent Enablement (LATC-10229) — 2 done this period · 75% complete overall
p: DataAgent research and DataForge 1.0 P0-P1 development closed. 75% complete. Implementation has started.
h3: Multimodal Capability Support for P7 Edge Device (LATC-4719) — 2 done this period · 87% complete overall
p: P7 multimodal embedding eval/optimize and a CLIP-only Qwen3.5-0.8B train closed. 87% complete. Edge multimodal is in the last mile.

p: One LATC Bench PE/safety eval closed under the model-index epic. Overall child completion is 0/7 in Jira (the Done ticket may not be linked as a child). Treat the index as not started from a rollup view.
